SUMMARY 
 
Software Engineer with hands-on experience in developing and deploying full-stack web applications through 
internships and real-world client projects. Proficient in JavaScript, PHP, Python, MySQL, MongoDB, and modern web 
technologies, with a strong foundation in software engineering principles, database management, and responsive web 
development. Eager to contribute to scalable software solutions while continuously learning modern technologies.

 Kottayam, Kerala 
Web Developer Intern 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 February 2025 – October 2025 
•

UNIQUE WORLD ROBOTICS 
 
 
 
 
             
 
 Kottayam, Kerala 
AI & ML Intern  
 
 
 
 
              
 
 
 June 17, 2025 – June 21, 2025 
• 
Built a machine learning-based Traffic Prediction System using Python and scikit-learn.  
• 
Performed data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation on real-world datasets.  
• 
Developed a Flask-based web interface for real-time traffic predictions. 
 
LEOPARD TECH LABS 
 
 
 
 
 
             
 
  Kottayam, Kerala 
Flutter Developer Intern  
 
 
 
 
            
 
 
June 2024 – July 2024 
• 
Built and refined front-end screens using Flutter and Dart for a cross-platform mobile app  
• 
Integrated Firebase Authentication and Firestore, ensuring real-time data sync and performance across devices 
 
PROJECTS 
Event Registration & Management Portal (stepone.jyteenskerala.org) 
Tools: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL 
• 
Developed a production-ready event registration and management portal using PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, 
and JavaScript.  
• 
Implemented secure participant registration, authentication, and an administrative dashboard for managing 
registrations and event data.  
• 
Successfully deployed the application for real-world event management.  
 
Appointment Booking System 
Tools: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MongoDB 
• 
Built a full-stack appointment booking system with authentication and scheduling functionality.  
• 
Designed MongoDB collections and optimized CRUD operations for efficient data management.  
• 
Developed an administrative approval workflow for managing appointments.  
 
Fact-Based Comparison of News Articles  
Tools: Python, Web Scraping, NLP, SBERT, NLI-BERT 
• 
Developed an AI-powered system for extracting and comparing factual information from news articles across 
multiple media sources.  
• 
Applied web scraping, NLP, SBERT embeddings, and NLI models to identify common, contradictory, and 
omitted facts.  
• 
Improved factual comparison accuracy through semantic similarity and contradiction detection techniques. 
SKILLS 
 
HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, PHP, Node.js, MySQL, MongoDB, Python, Flask, Git, Java, C, NumPy, Pandas
